A: Maximum positive normalized perpendicular chord distance, primary total fitted objective, K=1..6; no monotonic envelope
A_sensitivity: Upper K=3,4,5,6; total objective and position MSE; both weights
B: Prominent speed lobes separated by lowest sample between adjacent retained peaks; endpoints cover crop

B_sensitivity.note: Counts only for sensitivity grid; fit nominal candidate setting only

fairness: Same raw targets, endpoints and solver. A reuses ten common starts per K; B-native uses five uniform plus five detected-valley starts. B-common uses same common starts as A at B-selected K to isolate initialization effect. Same per-fit cap, not equal total search cost.
scope: Two-window count-selector comparison, not biological truth or validation of universal thresholds

nominal_detection.rule: One speed lobe per retained prominent peak, interior boundaries at lowest sample between adjacent peaks; crop endpoints cover edges; no peaks falls back to K=1
